identity.name: Cosmograph Daytona
identity.one_liner: The steel Daytona whose ceramic bezel and multi-year waitlists defined the 2016-2023 hype market.

narrative.story: Rolex put a black Cerachrom bezel on the steel Daytona in 2016, visually recalling the black-bezel 6241 of the 1960s and immediately dating the outgoing 116520. Demand outran supply for its entire seven-year run: authorized dealers kept multi-year lists and the watch traded at a large premium over retail throughout, peaking in early 2022. Discontinued in 2023 for the 126500LN, it remains the shorthand example of the retail-versus-grey-market gap.
narrative.collector_notes: White 'panda' dials carry a consistent premium over black. Check the bezel edge for chips and the warranty-card date; 2023-dated full sets mark the final production year.
